item.blurb: TechNovaTime Raises $3.4M Pre-seed. TechNovaTime raises $3.4M in pre-seed funding led by AIN Ventures to scale its AI platform for healthcare administrative workflow automation.
Popcorn AI Studio Raises $1M Pre-seed. Popcorn AI Studio raises $1M in pre-seed funding led by Mohammed Bin Bouta Alharsoosi to expand its AI-powered filmmaking platform in the Middle East.
Syncrowin Raises $3M Pre-seed. Syncrowin raises $3 million in pre-seed funding led by Collide Capital to expand its industrial AI platform for factory and energy maintenance.
Otter Health Raises $8M Seed. Otter Health raises $8 million in seed funding led by Fika Ventures and Evidenced to scale its AI platform for healthcare utilization and quality management.
Homa Raises $5M Seed. Homa raises $5M in seed funding led by Quiet Capital to expand its AI-powered homebuying platform and integrate mortgage lending services.
Aerium Raises $2.5M Seed. Aerium raises $2.5 million in a seed round from Gutter Capital and angel investors to expand its AI workforce platform for the manufacturing sector.
Geniez AI Raises $6M Seed. Geniez AI raises $6M in seed funding co-led by StageOne Ventures and Canapi Ventures to connect LLMs and AI agents with real-time mainframe data.
Antithesis Raises $105M Series A. Antithesis raises $105M Series A round led by Jane Street to expand its deterministic software-testing platform and scale global operations.
FlexM Secures Series A Funding. FlexM raises a Series A round from 24 Hermes VCC to scale its global payments, remittance, and compliance infrastructure platform.
Abby Care Raises $82M Series C. Abby Care raises $82M in Series C funding led by Transformation Capital to expand its AI-powered family caregiving platform.
Meow Secures Strategic Investment. Meow Technologies secures strategic investment from Stifel Financial to expand its white-label treasury management and digital banking platform.
